adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new actions `addMembers` and `removeMember` call `this.get("model").addMembers(...)` / `removeMember(...)` without any `.catch`/failure callback (and `addMembers` doesn’t even `return` the promise). The model methods in `group.js` perform `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` but also lack explicit error handling. The diff therefore supports the specific review concern that mutation failures (e.g., 422 from `can_not_modify_automatic`) are not handled at this call site; however, the claim that errors are “swallowed” and the UI becomes “unresponsive-looking” can’t be strictly verified from the diff alone because there may be global AJAX error handling elsewhere.
